service.method: SELECT BUPR.HOUSE_CODE ,BUPR.BIZ_CODE ,BUPR.BIZ_CATEGORY ,BUPR.BIZ_TYPE ,BUPR.SELLER_NAME_LOC ,BUPR.IRS_NO ,BUPR.ZIP_CODE ,BUPR.ADDRESS_LOC ,BUPR.PHONE_NO ,BUPR.EMAIL ,BUPR.CEO_NAME_LOC ,BUPR.FOUNDATION_DATE ,BUPI.USER_ID ,BUPI.USER_NAME ,BUPI.EMAIL AS MANAGER_EMAIL ,BUPI.PHONE_NO AS MANAGER_PHONE_NO FROM SBUPR BUPR INNER JOIN SBUPI BUPI ON BUPR.HOUSE_CODE = BUPI.HOUSE_CODE AND BUPR.BIZ_CODE = BUPI.BIZ_CODE WHERE BUPR.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BUPR.BIZ_CODE = ${BIZ_CODE} AND BUPI.USER_ID = ${SIGNER_ID}
